commit_message:
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@143db483b8b9 (#25295)

The following fix needs to be kept:
- [[mlir][VectorToGPU] Reconsider cached slices after rejected
candidates](https://github.com/iree-org/llvm-project/commit/143db483b8b9113591cd50d77ff05640a51124ff)

We also needed to fold slices of empty tensors before `scf.forall`
canonicalization would tie them to `shared_outs`, due to changes
introduced in:
 - https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/241838

A GPU lit test had to be adjusted to account for that as well.

The TOSA `allowNonFinities` option had to be explicitly set back to
false, to not break WebGPU. The default was changed in upstream MLIR:
 - https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/239407
 - related: https://github.com/iree-org/iree/issues/11321

The bump also exposed pre-existing UB, fixed by replacing `std::abs`
with `llvm::AbsoluteValue`.

Assisted-by: Codex

Signed-off-by: Maksymilian B. Knust <knust@roofline.ai>

commit_message:
[Codegen][CPU] Honor --iree-llvmcpu-skip-intermediate-roundings=false for RVV Zvfhmin f16 inner_tiled MMA (#25125)

Zvfhmin lacks native f16 MAC, so f16 MMA widens accumulator to f32
then truncates back. These extf/truncf pairs were marked as invertible
and hoisted out of K loop, dropping per-K rounding and producing wrong
answers. The skip-intermediate-roundings flag was not plumbed into
lowering at all.

Propagate skipIntermediateRoundings through inner tile lowering and the
LLVMCPU vector pipelines. When we need to preserve roundings
(widenF16Acc
&& !skipIntermediateRoundings), materialize the f16 -> f32 -> f16
round-trip directly around each MA step in emitIntrinsic, and drop the
hoistable distribute/reassemble accumulator pair.

Add tests covering both keep-rounding and skip-rounding modes.

Fixes: https://github.com/iree-org/iree/issues/25058
Assisted-by: Claude Code, Doubao, DeepSeek

Signed-off-by: Yalong <yalong@multicorewareinc.com>
name: Tag candidate release
